profile.headline: Founder & Technical Lead at Reactor | Building the workflow connectivity layer between applications and blockchain
profile.summary: With over a decade of experience in technology innovation, currently leading Archly Reactor Inc. as Founder and Principal Software Engineer, specializing in web services and scalable web applications. Previously served as Founder and Software Engineer at Pivent Inc., fostering impactful systems over seven years. Collaborated on cutting-edge projects as a Software Engineer at Microsoft, contributing to robust software architectures. Archly Reactor’s mission aligns with advancing transformative tech solutions, and my role empowers teams to create impactful products. Passionate about leveraging technical expertise to deliver solutions that address complex challenges and drive growth.

patents.title: Distributed computing over a wireless ad hoc network
patents.description: A telecommunication environment including a wireless transmitter in a first mobile device that enables the first mobile device to communicate over a network infrastructure. An application may be executed in the first mobile device such that the application enables the first mobile device to communicate with a second mobile device over a wireless ad hoc network.

patents.title: Distributed computing over a wireless ad hoc network
patents.description: A telecommunication environment including a wireless transmitter in a first mobile device that enables the first mobile device to communicate over a network infrastructure. An application may be executed in the first mobile device such that the application enables the first mobile device to communicate with a second mobile device over a wireless ad hoc network. The application may further facilitate a requisitioning of a remote computer resource of the second mobile device over the wireless ad hoc network.
